instruction: Candid corporate photograph, medium full shot. In a minimalist office with a light gray wall, a group of five colleagues stand in a semi-circle, stacking their hands in the center. From left to right: the blonde woman in a white shirt (R4) in profile, the woman in a plaid blazer (R2) facing right, the dark-haired woman in a beige sweater (R3) in the center background, the wavy-haired blonde woman in a white cable-knit sweater (R1) facing left, and the young man in a white shirt (R5) in profile. They are all smiling and extending their arms to join hands. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene.
elements: R1 faces left while extending her arm into the central stacked-hands interaction toward the group, not R2 taking that facing-left role
R2 faces right while extending her arm into the central stacked-hands interaction toward the group, not R1 taking that facing-right role
R3 is the center-background participant who still joins the central hand stack
R1, R2, R3, R4, and R5 each extend an arm so their hands meet in one shared central stack
R4 and R5 participate in profile while reaching into the shared hand stack rather than acting as bystanders
The interaction takes place in a minimalist office with a light gray wall
